body.statement: Fix a component \(T_j\). Positive rational arrays \((\widetilde a_v,\widetilde b_{v\mid u})\) are the vertex variances and both directed-edge regression residuals of a rational positive-definite Gaussian covariance faithful to \(T_j\) if and only if, for every edge \(uv\), there is \(h_{uv}\in(0,1)\cap\mathbb Q\) with \(\widetilde b_{v\mid u}=\widetilde a_vh_{uv}\), \(\widetilde b_{u\mid v}=\widetilde a_uh_{uv}\), and \(\widetilde a_u\widetilde a_v(1-h_{uv})\) a nonzero square in \(\mathbb Q\). Choose a signed rational square root \(c_{uv}\ne0\) on every edge and define the matrix piecewise by \[M_{xx}=\widetilde a_x,\qquad M_{xy}=\frac{\prod_{uv\in\operatorname{path}(x,y)}c_{uv}}{\prod_{z\in\operatorname{intpath}(x,y)}\widetilde a_z}\quad(x\ne y).\] For every root \(r\in V(T_j)\), the linear SEM oriented away from \(r\), with edge coefficient \(c_{uv}/\widetilde a_u\) for \(u\to v\), root innovation variance \(\widetilde a_r\), and nonroot innovation variance \(\widetilde a_vh_{uv}>0\) for \(u\to v\), has covariance exactly \(M\). Consequently \(M\) is positive definite and faithful to \(T_j\), and on every edge \(uv\) it satisfies \(M_{vv}-M_{vu}^{2}/M_{uu}=\widetilde a_vh_{uv}=\widetilde b_{v\mid u}\) and \(M_{uu}-M_{uv}^{2}/M_{vv}=\widetilde a_uh_{uv}=\widetilde b_{u\mid v}\). Conversely, every rational positive-definite covariance faithful to \(T_j\) yields these conditions with \(c_{uv}=M_{uv}\), obeys the same piecewise tree-product formula, and has nonzero edge covariances. Each path entry uses at most \(|V(T_j)|-1\) rational products and divisions, so all entries have bit length polynomial in the slot representation. As a nonunit-diagonal check, for the path \(1-2-3\), take \((\widetilde a_1,\widetilde a_2,\widetilde a_3)=(3,7/4,23/16)\), \((c_{12},c_{23})=(3/2,7/8)\), and \((h_{12},h_{23})=(4/7,16/23)\). The formula gives \[M=\begin{pmatrix}3&3/2&3/4\\3/2&7/4&7/8\\3/4&7/8&23/16\end{pmatrix},\] whose leading principal minors are \(3,3,3\); its directed residuals are \((\widetilde b_{2\mid1},\widetilde b_{1\mid2})=(1,12/7)\) and \((\widetilde b_{3\mid2},\widetilde b_{2\mid3})=(1,28/23)\), and its nonzero edge covariances make the Gaussian path faithful.
body.justification: The piecewise construction and arbitrary-root SEM identity isolate exactly which abstract label gadgets compile into faithful rational Gaussian tree signatures.
body.gap: BoegeKubjasMisraSolus2026 gives rational parameter recovery and fixed-color model ideals but not inverse simultaneous realization across alternative roots or bit-complexity control.
body.consumer: A hardness reduction for \(\textsc{K-Fiber}\) may invoke this certificate only after checking its edge residuals, positive definiteness, faithfulness, rationality, and bit length; algorithms can exploit the same forced identities.
